errata.error: DMI's documentation says the Danish Coastal Authority's gauges measure in DVR90, and the store labels their `sea_reg` DVR90, but until 27 or 28 May 2002 it's on an older reference, likely DNN, 5 to 20 cm above DVR90.
errata.response: Values before 29 May 2002 aren't fetched, so these gauges' records in the store start on that day.
errata.evidence: Against DMI's `sealev_dvr` at the same or a nearby gauge, 29 of the 36 gauges read 5 to 20 cm higher over 12 to 25 May 2002 than over 29 May to 11 June (11 cm at Vidåslusen/Højer and 13 cm at Esbjerg, both beside a DMI gauge); the three in Ringkøbing Fjord drop 9 to 11 cm within an hour on 28 May. At the eastern harbors the `I` and `II` gauges disagree by up to 20 cm through late 2002, and at Fåborg, Karrebæksminde and Kalvehave the difference between them changed by 7 to 22 cm at the switch; they agree within 1 cm by 2004.

errata.error: The Coastal Authority's `I` and `II` gauges at Fåborg, Karrebæksminde and Kalvehave, beside each other, disagree by up to 20 cm through late 2002, and the difference between them changed by 7 to 22 cm when they moved to DVR90 in May 2002, so at least one of each pair is off DVR90 in those years.
errata.response: Kept as DMI serves them, labeled DVR90; which gauge of each pair is right isn't known.
errata.evidence: Median hourly difference between each pair over 12 to 25 May 2002, 29 May to 11 June 2002, September 2002 and May 2004: Fåborg 26, 4, −20 and 1 cm; Karrebæksminde 4, −3, −9 and −1 cm; Kalvehave 21, 2, 0 and −1 cm.
